neighbours.label: the modal or 'also' just before the verb in a 'usually A, but it can also B' clause, across languages (can also, may, могут, peuvent aussi): the slot where a second, less obvious action is about to be named
fire: A cough is usually harmless, but it can also point to a serious infection.
These clouds often bring rain, but they can also mean the wind is changing.
Old letters tell us about daily life, but they may also reveal family secrets.
Ce symptôme est souvent bénin, mais il peut aussi annoncer une maladie grave.
Такие боли обычно проходят сами, но могут указывать и на болезнь.
A smile usually shows joy, but it can also hide deep sadness.
Fever normally fights infection, but it may also harm very young children.
Ces règles protègent les clients, mais elles peuvent aussi freiner les petites entreprises.
quiet: A cough is usually harmless and goes away after a week or so.
These clouds often bring rain in the late afternoon in summer.
Old letters tell us about daily life in the villages of the north.
Ce symptôme est souvent bénin et disparaît après quelques jours.
Такие боли обычно проходят сами через несколько дней.
A smile usually shows joy to the people around us.
Fever normally fights infection and lasts a day or two.
Ces règles protègent les clients depuis plus de dix ans.
